description: An amber suburban train circles a dark workspace, adding coaches at prompt milestones.

theme.name: Virar Fast

/* The track and rolling stock share a single local coordinate system. */
@property --loop-line-lap {
  syntax: '<percentage>';
  inherits: true;
  initial-value: 0%;
}
@keyframes loop-line-run {
  from { --loop-line-lap: 0%; }
  to { --loop-line-lap: 100%; }
}
[data-chat-column]:not([inert], [data-side-chat-pane] *) > div:has(> [data-chat-canvas]) {
  contain: layout;
  isolation: isolate;
  padding: 36px;
  --loop-rail: #393936;
  --loop-tie: #32322f;
  --loop-ballast: #191918;
  background-color: #171716;
}
[data-chat-column]:not([inert], [data-side-chat-pane] *) > div:has(> [data-chat-canvas])::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset: 16px;
  border: 8px double var(--loop-rail);
  border-radius: 37px;
  padding: 0;
  background-origin: border-box;
  background:
    repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, var(--loop-tie) 0 2px, transparent 2px 8px) top / 100% 8px,
    repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, var(--loop-tie) 0 2px, transparent 2px 8px) bottom / 100% 8px,
    repeating-linear-gradient(0deg, var(--loop-tie) 0 2px, transparent 2px 8px) left / 8px 100%,
    repeating-linear-gradient(0deg, var(--loop-tie) 0 2px, transparent 2px 8px) right / 8px 100%,
    var(--loop-ballast);
  background-origin: border-box;
  background-repeat: no-repeat;
  mask: linear-gradient(black 0 0) content-box, linear-gradient(black 0 0);
  mask-composite: exclude;
  pointer-events: none;
}

/* Each carriage follows the same curve at a fixed coupler distance. */
